faq.question: How long does shipping take?
faq.answer: Most orders ship within 2 business days. Each product page shows its delivery estimate.

faq.question: Can I return gear I have used?
faq.answer: We take back unused gear within 30 days. Used gear is covered by the maker's warranty.

faq.question: How do I pick a tent size?
faq.answer: Choose one size up from the number of sleepers if you want room for gear inside.

faq.question: How do I wash a waterproof shell?
faq.answer: Use a technical wash on a gentle cycle, then tumble dry low to restore the water repellency.

faq.question: Can I pick up an order in person?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose pickup at checkout and collect your order at our Denver or Portland warehouse.
